official.deadline_central_display: 13 October 2026, 17:00 CEST (cloture du depot et enregistrement Etape I)
official.deadline_note: The call opened 16 July 2026 at 09:00 CEST. Step 1 (Etape I) submission and registration closes 13 October 2026 at 17:00 (heure de Paris). Step 1 results are notified to coordinators in mid-February 2027; step 2 opens end of February 2027 and closes end of March 2027; the right of reply to reviews opens on IRIS in week 20 of May 2027 and the list of selected projects is published in July 2027 (PRCI results from September to December 2027).
official.status_note: The ANR call page displays the call as 'Ouvert - 2027'; step 1 submission and registration closes 13 October 2026 at 17:00 CEST, three days after this verification.
benefits: Project-based research funding awarded through five instruments: JCJC (jeune chercheur - jeune chercheuse), PRME (projet de recherche mono-equipe), PRC (projet de recherche collaborative), PRCE (collaborative with socio-economic openness) and PRCI (international bilateral collaboration)

PRCE step 1 registrations that meet the step 1 eligibility criteria receive an automatic invitation to step 2, without assessment of the scientific value of the registration by the scientific evaluation committees
eligibility: Open to all scientific communities and to all public or private actors involved in French research
Covers all scientific fields and all disciplines, including fundamental, exploratory and finalised research

Structured into 57 research axes, each corresponding to a scientific evaluation committee (CES) of the same name: 38 axes within 7 disciplinary domains and 19 cross-cutting trans- or interdisciplinary axes
Coordinators choose the funding instrument and the research axis when submitting or registering the project; these choices cannot be changed during the selection process
PRCI collaborations must be confirmed against the dedicated bilateral annex - for 2027 the ANR-FRQ (franco-quebecoise) and ANR-NSF collaborations are both suspended
requirements: Complete step 1 submission and registration on the IRIS portal before 13 October 2026 at 17:00 CEST
Choose the research axis, and therefore the scientific evaluation committee, at submission; it cannot be modified during the selection process
For the PRCE instrument in step 1, complete only the online project characterisation form and the online CVs of the coordinators and partner scientific leads - no scientific document is required
For PRCI, consult the dedicated bilateral annex to confirm the collaboration is open, its submission modality and its themes before registering

AAPG 2026 complementary-list projects redeposited at step 1 are automatically invited to step 2, provided they have the same coordinator, same funding instrument, same title and a comparable consortium, and are complete at the step 1 closing date and time
documents: AAPG 2027: Texte de l'appel a projets (anr-aapg-2027.pdf)
Annexe budgetaire specifique aux partenaires francais - obligatoire pour les collaborations en Lead etranger
Relevant PRCI bilateral collaboration annexes (DFG, FWF, CNPq, FACEPE, FAPESP, RGC, FNR, NRF, FNS, NSTC)
selection_criteria: PRCE step 1: registrations meeting the step 1 eligibility criteria receive an automatic invitation to step 2, without scientific evaluation of the registration by the CES

Step 1 results are notified to coordinators in mid-February 2027; a right of reply to the reviews opens on IRIS in week 20 of May 2027; the list of projects selected for funding is published in July 2027
PRCI selection requires joint agreement of both funding agencies, and each agency ultimately funds the teams of its own country
coverage: Project-based research funding supporting fundamental, exploratory or finalised research in all scientific fields and disciplines
application_method: Choose the funding instrument (JCJC, PRME, PRC, PRCE, PRCI) and the research axis (and therefore the CES) that best matches the project's scientific objectives
For PRCE in step 1, complete only the online project characterisation form and the CVs of coordinators and partner scientific leads
For JCJC, PRME and PRC (and PRCE from step 2), submit the pre-proposal using the published template on the IRIS portal
For PRCI, consult the dedicated bilateral annex, and in foreign Lead Agency modality submit a copy of the project to the foreign agency within the timetable set in that annex
Complete submission and registration before 13 October 2026 at 17:00 CEST
official.application_route: Submit and register the project on the ANR's IRIS portal (iris.anr.fr) by 13 October 2026, 17:00 CEST.
official.citizenship_residency: No citizenship rule is published on the call page; the AAPG 2027 is addressed to all scientific communities and all public or private actors involved in French research, with PRCI collaborations involving partner agencies abroad under the bilateral annexes.
official.international_eligibility: The PRCI instrument funds international bilateral collaborations with partner agencies (annexes published for DFG, FWF, CNPq, FACEPE, FAPESP, RGC, FNR, NRF, FNS and NSTC); the ANR-FRQ and ANR-NSF collaborations are suspended for the 2027 edition.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: All scientific fields and disciplines; the project must be assigned to one of the 57 research axes, each corresponding to a scientific evaluation committee.
official.research_requirement: A pre-proposal must be submitted for the JCJC, PRME and PRC instruments (and PRCE from step 2) using the published template; for PRCE in step 1 only the online project characterisation form and the coordinator and partner CVs are required.
official.description: Principal call of the Agence nationale de la recherche, the Appel a projets generique 2027 is addressed to all scientific communities and all public or private actors involved in French research. It supports project-based research in all scientific domains and disciplines, giving full place to fundamental, exploratory or finalised research in an approach guided by researchers' curiosity, and mobilises five funding instruments from single-team to international collaboration.
official.program_type: Government research funding call (ANR generic call for proposals)

verification.notes: Read the ANR's own call page for the AAPG 2027 in full on 2026-10-10; the opening date (16 July 2026, 09:00 CEST), the step 1 closing date and time (13 October 2026, 17:00 CEST), the calendar, the 57 research axes, the five funding instruments, the PRCE step 1 modality, the PRCI submission modalities and the suspended ANR-FRQ and ANR-NSF collaborations are confirmed as published. The page publishes no funding amounts; per-instrument amounts live in the call text and the ANR financial regulations.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a project funding call for research teams, not an individual scholarship - a doctoral contract arises only if a selected project recruits one, so a student cannot apply directly. The operative deadline is step 1 on the IRIS portal, 13 October 2026 at 17:00 Paris time, and both the funding instrument and the research axis are locked at submission and cannot be changed during selection. PRCE registrants get a light step 1 (characterisation form plus CVs, no scientific document) and an automatic step 2 invitation if the step 1 criteria are met, while PRCI applicants must check the bilateral annexes first - the ANR-FRQ and ANR-NSF collaborations are both suspended for 2027.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Research coordinators at French institutions with a project ready for one of the five instruments (JCJC, PRME, PRC, PRCE, PRCI) who can complete IRIS submission and registration before 13 October 2026.
application_readiness_checklist: Decide which funding instrument fits before opening IRIS, because the instrument cannot be changed after submission
Choose the research axis and its scientific evaluation committee deliberately, reading the axis descriptions in the call text even if redepositing from a previous edition
Download the call text, the guide, the step 1 FAQ (V2.0) and the pre-proposal template from the call page
For PRCI, read the dedicated bilateral annex to confirm the collaboration is open, its modality and its themes, and note that ANR-FRQ and ANR-NSF are suspended for 2027
If you were on the AAPG 2026 complementary list, keep the same coordinator, instrument, title and a comparable consortium to be reinvited automatically to step 2
If you were selected for funding at the 2026 edition, cancel your 2027 PRCI registration or JCJC/PRME/PRC submission or PRCE registration by email to aapg.science@anr.fr
common_rejection_risks: A PRCI registration submitted under a collaboration that is suspended for 2027 (ANR-FRQ, ANR-NSF)
Missing the 17:00 CEST server deadline on 13 October 2026 for step 1 submission and registration
A 2026-funded laureat who leaves a duplicate 2027 registration in place
Complementary-list projects that change partnership and no longer meet the new PRC expectations for 2027
Choosing an axis that does not match the project's scientific objectives, since the CES assignment cannot be corrected later
document_audit: All call documents are downloadable from the call page; use the current FAQ etape 1 (V2.0) rather than older circulating versions
The pre-proposal template (Trame de la pre-proposition) is the mandatory drafting basis for JCJC, PRME and PRC
A specific budget annex for French partners is mandatory for collaborations in foreign Lead Agency modality
alerts: Step 1 closes 13 October 2026 at 17:00 CEST - a hard portal deadline only days after this verification
The ANR-NSF collaboration suspension was updated as recently as 07/10/2026, so re-check the annexes before registering a PRCI project
Step 2 runs from end February to end March 2027, with a right-of-reply window on IRIS in week 20 of May 2027 and results in July 2027 (PRCI September-December 2027)
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: The coordinator submits and registers the project on IRIS by 13 October 2026 at 17:00 CEST; ANR notifies step 1 results in mid-February 2027; invited teams submit the full proposal by end of March 2027; the selected list is published in July 2027, with PRCI results following the bilateral negotiations from September to December 2027.
